title: Track-Oriented Multi-Hypothesis Tracker
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Track_Oriented_Multi_Hypothesis_Tracker.md
text: Track-Oriented Multi-Hypothesis Tracker，输入 5 路、输出 5 路；按 {Track output method} 指定航迹输出方法；{Tracker identifier} 指定唯一跟踪器标识符、{Filter initialization function} 指定滤波器初始化函数、{Threshold for assigning detections to tracks} 指定将检测分配给航迹的阈值 30*、{Maximum number of tracks} 指定最大航迹数、{Maximum number of sensors} 指定最大传感器数、{Out-of-sequence measurements handling} 指定乱序测量处理、{Track state parameters} 指定航迹状态参考系的参数 structure、{Update track state parameters with time} 指定随时间更新航迹状态参数、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted、{Maximum number of hypotheses to be maintained} 指定要维护的最大假设数、{Maximum number of track branches per track} 指定每条航迹的最大航迹分支数、{Maximum number of scans maintained in the branch history} 指定分支历史中维护的最大扫描数、{Minimum probability required to keep a branch} 指定保留分支所需的最小概率 .001、{N-scan pruning method} 指定 N 扫描剪枝方法、{Confirmation threshold [positive scalar]} 指定确认航迹所需的最小得分、{Deletion threshold [negative scalar]} 指定航迹删除的最大得分下降、{Probability of detection used for track score} 用于航迹得分的检测概率、{Rate of false positives used for track score} 用于航迹得分的虚警概率 1e-6、{Volume of the sensor’s detection bin} 指定传感器测量单元的体积、{Rate of new tracks per unit volume} 指定单位体积的新航迹速率、{Prediction time source} 指定预测时间来源、{Enable cost matrix input} 启用代价矩阵输入端口、{Enable detectable branch IDs input} 启用可检测分支 ID 输入、{Enable tentative tracks output} 启用暂定航迹输出端口、{Enable all tracks output} 启用所有航迹输出端口、{Enable information output} 启用分析信息的输出端口、{Enable all branches output} 启用所有分支的输出端口、{Source of output bus name} 输出航迹总线名称的来源、{Source of output info bus name} 输出信息总线名称的来源，按实例取值。

params.name: Tracker identifier
params.values: 唯一跟踪器标识符 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.values: 滤波器初始化函数 @initcvekf (default) | function name

params.name: Threshold for assigning detections to tracks
params.values: 将检测分配给航迹的阈值 30*[0.3 0.7 1 Inf] (default) | positive scalar | 1-by-3 vector of positive values | 1-by-4 vector of positive values

params.name: Maximum number of tracks
